authority: PROMPT PR3 v1.2.1 + A02/A03/A05 v1.2/A06 v1.2 + promoted local runtimes
purpose: Preserve local runtime identities while giving every logical PR3 record an exact reproducible uniqueness/idempotency rule. This is technical binding, not semantic reinterpretation.

canonicalization_profile.name: EVE-PR3-KEY-CANONICALIZATION-v1
canonicalization_profile.field_order: EXACT key_fields order declared in each key profile; never alphabetical unless a nested JSON object is canonicalized
canonicalization_profile.integer: base-10 without sign normalization beyond ordinary decimal rendering
canonicalization_profile.decimal: hash-critical decimal fields MUST be serialized as contract-declared strings; binary floating-point values are forbidden in identity preimages
canonicalization_profile.string: exact Unicode code points supplied by authoritative source; no trim, case-fold, or Unicode normalization
canonicalization_profile.timestamp: UTC RFC3339 with exactly six fractional digits and Z suffix, e.g. 2026-10-01T18:09:00.000000Z
canonicalization_profile.json_object: RFC8785-style intent: recursively sort object keys lexicographically; UTF-8; no insignificant whitespace; strings preserved; numbers must comply with field contract
canonicalization_profile.json_array: preserve source-authorized order; never sort arrays unless the source contract explicitly defines set semantics
canonicalization_profile.display_id: <prefix>-<first24(identity_sha256)> unless a source contract supplies the canonical ID itself

local_identity_preservation.rule: Never rewrite a promoted runtime local ID. Persist local ID and PR3 technical identity side-by-side.
local_identity_preservation.B0: Reference runtime may use UUIDs; preserve as local_run_id/local_response_id where emitted. PR3 keys are additive.
local_identity_preservation.B0.5: Reference interaction IDs may be run-sequential; preserve them as local_interaction_instance_id. PR3 interaction_key is additive.

B1.rule: Preserve B1 local stable IDs verbatim; do not recompute with the PR3 key profile.

B2.rule: Preserve B2 local stable IDs verbatim; response UUIDs remain local IDs. PR3 technical response_key is additive.

run_and_revision_allocation.run_ordinal: Allocated transactionally within (chain_definition_id, revision, case_id, participant_id, role_id, activity_id) only when an explicit NEW_RUN command is accepted. Retries reuse the already allocated ordinal.
run_and_revision_allocation.execution_ordinal: Fixed by A03 node order for the first traversal: B0=1, B0.5=2, B1=3, B2=4. A reentry does not mint a second object identity unless the causal owner begins a new object execution; resume/retry reuses object_run_id.
run_and_revision_allocation.opening_ordinal: Monotonic within one object_run_id and runtime_definition_id; allocated exactly once when an interaction opening is accepted. Retries reuse it.
run_and_revision_allocation.response_revision: Starts at 1. An accepted correction creates revision n+1 and sets supersedes_response_key to exact prior PR3 key; prior row is immutable.
run_and_revision_allocation.canonical_variable_revision: Starts at 1 per (object_run_id, variable_id); new accepted value or derivation result creates n+1; prior revision remains addressable.
run_and_revision_allocation.candidate_revision: Starts at 1 per (object_run_id,target_id); changes create n+1.
run_and_revision_allocation.package_revision: Starts at 1 per (producer_object_run_id, package_type, binding_id). Increment iff canonical bound payload_sha256 changes. Re-release of identical payload reuses revision and material_package_id.
run_and_revision_allocation.context_revision: Opaque authoritative revision string. Any change stales dependent AI proposals/renders/evaluations but does not silently rewrite user evidence.

idempotency_profile.name: EVE-PR3-IDEMPOTENCY-v1.2-COMMAND-RECEIPT
idempotency_profile.payload_sha256_rule: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the operation payload; 64 lowercase hex. Transport credentials/signatures may be excluded only if A04 declares them non-semantic and the bound semantic payload is otherwise identical.
idempotency_profile.first_execution_atomicity: Persist immutable CommandReceipt atomically with every semantic/control side effect of the command. For REJECTED_PRECONDITION, persist a receipt with zero semantic side_effect_refs so the exact rejection can be replayed.
idempotency_profile.replay_same_key_same_payload: Return the exact persisted result_payload_json (or immutable result ref) from the original CommandReceipt; no new response/evidence/budget/presentation/handoff/AI/admission/ordinal side effect.
idempotency_profile.same_key_different_payload: Return IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; no semantic write; original CommandReceipt and original side effects remain unchanged.
idempotency_profile.correction: A deliberate correction receives a new command_event_id/client_event_id, creates response revision n+1 and explicit supersedes; prior response and prior CommandReceipt are immutable.
idempotency_profile.open_or_resume: OPEN_OR_RESUME idempotency is established before chain/object/interaction IDs exist, using scope/activity/chain-definition scope + client_event_id. Replay returns exactly the original allocated run/object/interaction identifiers and does not allocate a new ordinal.
idempotency_profile.resume: RESUME is keyed by chain + last-known context scope + client_event_id. Replay cannot duplicate PresentationEvent, charge, AI, or reentry side effects. If a new UI re-render is semantically warranted, that presentation identity is linked to the accepted command receipt and is itself idempotent.
idempotency_profile.issue_action_token: ISSUE_ACTION_TOKEN uses token_request_id as command_event_id. Same token_request_id+payload returns same client_event_id/action token; different payload conflicts. token_request_id is transport-only and never becomes business evidence.
idempotency_profile.internal_ai: Provider retries reuse the server command_event_id and CommandReceipt; a retry cannot create a second admitted proposal.
idempotency_profile.handoff: RELEASE, RECEIPT and CONSUMPTION remain separate event types; each command is receipt-bound and idempotent for its exact package/event/consumer scope.
idempotency_profile.read_state: READ_STATE is a pure read and is idempotent by absence of state mutation; no CommandReceipt write is required.
idempotency_profile.budget: Budget charge/ledger identities are side-effect refs of the accepted CommandReceipt. Replay cannot consume budget twice.

revision_and_supersession_invariants: Immutable prior revisions; no in-place overwrite of accepted evidence/response/canonical/package revisions.
UNKNOWN != FALSE; CANDIDATE != EVIDENCE; READY != PROMOTED; AI_PROPOSAL != USER_EVIDENCE.
A source/local ID and a PR3 technical ID are different namespaces and both are retained when both exist.
Context changes invalidate dependent projections; they do not retroactively change literal user evidence.
A downstream object never repairs an upstream missing/ambiguous field; reentry returns to the causal owner.

command_scope_profiles.explicit_note: Does not require chain_run_id/object_run_id/interaction_key before first commit.
Idempotency does not depend on creating a new interaction or presentation first.

command_scope_profiles.command_event_id_source: server_command_event_id allocated once and reused on provider retry
server_command_event_id or exact HandoffEvent identity allocated once

command_scope_profiles.idempotency_equivalent: Pure read performs no semantic/control write. Same authoritative state revision yields the same projection content hash; no receipt write is introduced merely to make a read idempotent.

command_receipt_invariants: CommandReceipt is an immutable logical record; replay never mutates the original receipt.

Original accepted/rejected receipt_state is persisted as ACCEPTED or REJECTED_PRECONDITION. IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY and IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT are response projection states referencing the immutable original receipt.
side_effect_refs enumerate every committed logical write caused by the command; an accepted retry adds none.
result_payload_sha256 must match the exact persisted replay payload/result reference.
OPEN_OR_RESUME and RESUME are covered without relying on IDs allocated after the command begins.
No browser-supplied idempotency_key is authoritative; server derives it from A07.
